integrity: The exact maximum, literal census, orbit decomposition, stabilizer orders, and distance profiles are reproduced by a standalone exhaustive verifier using exact integer arithmetic. Literature comparisons were made against full text where available and the exact-value database entry; an obscure unindexed historical census remains possible.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to binary length four and to equivalence under the standard Hamming-isometry group. No claim is made for larger dimensions or for a larger abstract automorphism group.
title: Two symmetry types of maximum binary length-four \(B_2\) codes
